title: 1D Gaussian Acquisition Smoke
intuition: Minimal sanity gate asking whether public training acquires a single scalar Gaussian N(2, 0.5^2) from random initialization within 1,000 updates, matching its mean, standard deviation, and full CDF (KS <= 0.05).
failure_mode: Broken critic scaling, NaN divergence, or collapsed variance prevents even a unimodal 1D Gaussian from converging within bounds.
protocol_notes: Produces the saved checkpoint consumed by `gaussian1d_stability`; requires independent same-state confirmation.
